صَبْحَةٌ : see the next paragraph, in three places. ―
-b2- Also A watering of camels in the morning, or first part of day, before sunrise: which is not esteemed by the Arabs wholesome: the time approved by them for watering is when the sun is near the meridian. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
